name: trailer-guard
description: Hook that guards commit trailers on the current branch: after every git command it flags your own commits that lost Signed-off-by, carry a Claude-Session line, or name a model in Assisted-by instead of the neutral Assisted-by: LLM, and it blocks git push, gh pr create/ready/merge and gh stack submit/sync/push/merge until they are fixed; a branch stacked on another local branch is judged and repaired from that branch's tip, and the repair recipe rewrites only your commits
